//: Streetwear · the first LIGHT theme: off-white paper over a flat periwinkle sky.
//1: THE source for every shell surface (quickshell/: bar, launcher, OSD, power
//2: menu). No upstream palette this time — every role is lifted from the
//3: wallpaper itself: the sky, the jacket, the yellow OFF-WHITE tag, the bob,
//4: the holographic pink, the teal eyes. `tokens` names each role after what
//5: it is in the picture so the mapping stays traceable. theme.lua still owns
//6: WINDOW chrome (gaps, border, blur, shadow); CI cross-checks it.
//7: Two-tone rule, paper edition: the yellow TAG is the frame, NAVY is the
//8: readout (and the text — on paper the readout IS ink), PINK is the launcher.
//9: No readoutBright on purpose: the active workspace is then solid `frame`, a
//10: yellow tag, instead of an emissive lozenge (see modules/Workspaces.qml).
name: streetwear
//tokens: What in the picture -> role, so a palette bump stays traceable.
//print: Two derived inks the terminal-side files share, because the tag's yellow (1.7:1) cannot carry TEXT on paper: tag ink #8a6b0e is `frame` printed, holo ink #c04a60 is `launcher` printed. Yellow stays for lines, fills and the cursor block.
//effects: Flat print: no glow (nothing is lit on paper), no scanlines (paper has no raster).
//bar: Bar identity. Paper islands: near-opaque off-white, a yellow tag edge at 55%, medium 10px corners. Opaque-ish on purpose — blue frosting through a light fill goes muddy, so the fill is paper and the wallpaper stays outside it.
//launcher: Launcher identity: a holographic-pink 2px frame around a paper sheet, 12px window, 8px input + rows.
//osd: OSD identity: a full pill with a 2px yellow tag frame, navy track.
//session: Power-menu identity: paper tiles with 14px corners and a 1px yellow edge at 60%, over a light scrim.
//wallpaper: Shared by hyprlock.conf (brightness) and sddm/Main.qml (1 - brightness scrim). 0.9, not 0.55: the picture is a light field, and the dark themes' dim would turn it to mud — the lock and the greeter are read with navy on sky, not cream on dusk.
